{"script": "cd /home/user && python3 << 'EOF'
import FreeCAD
import Part
from FreeCAD import Base

# Open the precondition file
doc = FreeCAD.open('/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd')

# Get dimensions of the existing part
pad = doc.getObject('Pad')
shape = pad.Shape
bbox = shape.BoundBox

print(f"Part Bounding Box:")
print(f"  X: {bbox.XMin:.2f} to {bbox.XMax:.2f}")
print(f"  Y: {bbox.YMin:.2f} to {bbox.YMax:.2f}")
print(f"  Z: {bbox.ZMin:.2f} to {bbox.ZMax:.2f}")

# Calculate stock dimensions with some margin
margin = 5  # 5mm margin on each side
stock_x_min = bbox.XMin - margin
stock_x_max = bbox.XMax + margin
stock_y_min = bbox.YMin - margin
stock_y_max = bbox.YMax + margin
stock_z_min = bbox.ZMin - margin
stock_z_max = bbox.ZMax + margin

stock_width = stock_x_max - stock_x_min
stock_depth = stock_y_max - stock_y_min
stock_height = stock_z_max - stock_z_min

print(f"\nStock dimensions:")
print(f"  Width (X): {stock_width:.2f}")
print(f"  Depth (Y): {stock_depth:.2f}")
print(f"  Height (Z): {stock_height:.2f}")

# Create stock as a box
stock_center = Base.Vector(
    (stock_x_min + stock_x_max) / 2,
    (stock_y_min + stock_y_max) / 2,
    (stock_z_min + stock_z_max) / 2
)

# Create a box for stock
box_shape = Part.makeBox(stock_width, stock_depth, stock_height, 
                          Base.Vector(stock_x_min, stock_y_min, stock_z_min))

# Create stock object in the document
stock_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Stock")
stock_obj.Shape = box_shape
stock_obj.Label = "Stock"

# Make sure the body is still visible and selected
doc.recompute()

print(f"\nStock created successfully")
print(f"Stock volume: {box_shape.Volume:.2f}")

# Save the document
doc.saveAs('/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd')
print("\nDocument saved to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

FreeCAD.closeDocument(doc.Name)
EOF"}

def createResourceClone(obj, orig, name, icon):
    clone = Draft.clone(orig)
    clone.Label = "%s-%s" % (name, orig.Label)
    clone.addProperty("App::PropertyString", "PathResource")
    clone.PathResource = name
    if clone.ViewObject:
        import Path.Base.Gui.IconViewProvider

        Path.Base.Gui.IconViewProvider.Attach(clone.ViewObject, icon)
        clone.ViewObject.Visibility = False
        clone.ViewObject.Transparency = 80
    obj.Document.recompute()  # necessary to create the clone shape
    return clone
